headline: Decades of abuse revealed at Michigan art school. And, the Iran war's impact on midterms
context: A new report has revealed decades of alleged abuse at an elite art school. NPR spoke with one of the victims. And, Iran is playing the long game with negotiations, which could impact midterms.
